title: Vampire Vape Heisenberg E-Liquid 10ml
description: Vampire Vape's Heisenberg E-Liquid is a truly unique and iconic blend of tangy wild berries and cooling menthol that is sure to please any vaper looking for a complex and satisfying vape indulgence. The genius of this E-Liquid lies in its ability to seamlessly fuse these dominant juicy fruit and menthol flavours into a harmonious whole that showcases the best characteristics of each. Upon inhale, rich and jammy forest fruits are complemented by sharp, jammy berry notes and hints of tropical fruit that tantalise the taste buds with waves of mouthwatering sweetness. This intricate flavour profile is then perfectly balanced by an icy-cool menthol exhale that refreshes and invigorates your tastebuds with every puff. Adding to the complexity of the blend is a subtle streak of aniseed that adds a captivating spicy kick to the Vampire Vape Heisenberg flavour. With this in mind it's really no surprise that the Vampire Vape Heisenberg E-Liquid has achieved cult status in the vaping community, spawning countless imitators who seek to replicate its deliciously unique flavour profile.
